audio.text: How many people signed up for the museum trip?

options: I signed the form this morning.
Almost thirty, so we'll need a bigger bus.
It opens at ten o'clock on weekends.
Yes, I've been to that museum twice with my class.

why.en: "How many" → a number. A repeats "signed" in another sense; C gives a time; D answers with "Yes".
why.tr: "How many" → sayı. A "signed" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; C saat veriyor; D "Yes" ile cevap veriyor.
why.es: "How many" → una cantidad. A repite "signed" con otro sentido; C da una hora; D responde "Yes".
